svg.aria-label: Homozygous example aligned with the wild-type control
svg.text: Accept · Homozygous for the intended edit

g.title: L173L: clone codon CTC (L), control CTG, designed CTC
Q174Q: clone codon CAA (Q), control CAG, designed CAA
R176C: clone codon TGC (C), control CGC, designed TGC
A178A: clone codon GCT (A), control GCA, designed GCT
V179V: clone codon GTC (V), control GTG, designed GTC

svg.text: Shaded column: designed change (orange blocks a PAM, purple is the edit). Dashed red line: cut.
Red base: differs from the control. Grey block: bases the clone lacks. The clone is laid onto the control at the offset used in the analysis.
Protein row: the control in the reading frame of the design. Box under a clone: its residue at each designed codon (as designed: purple or orange; as the control: grey; other: red).
